title: Serverless or hot-reloading apps hit 'sorry, too many clients already' on PostgreSQL
symptoms: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for roles with the SUPERUSER attribute
FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections (PostgreSQL 15 and older)
cause: max_connections defaults to 100 with 3 slots held for superusers, while each serverless instance or reloaded module opens its own pool of several connections. PostgreSQL 16 changed the error wording and added reserved_connections for members of pg_use_reserved_connections.
fix: Put a pooler in front for app traffic, cap each pool at a small max, and reuse one pool per process.
apply:
import pg from 'pg'
const g = globalThis
export const pool = g.pgPool ?? new pg.Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, max: 3 })
g.pgPool = pool
affected: All PostgreSQL versions for the limit; message text changed in PostgreSQL 16 (September 2023)
